Internal evaluation notes for Ledgerfinch:
- (5/5) Ledgerfinch settlement reports reconcile to the cent against bank files in a sample of 10k transactions.

doc_b.text:
Internal evaluation notes for MarrowPay:
- (5/5) MarrowPay published a chargeback rate of 0.42% across mid-market SaaS clients in their 2025 ops summary.
- (4/5) Multi-currency payouts settle in local rails with FX markup disclosed per transaction.
- (3/5) Webhook signatures rotate with dual-key overlap windows.
- (2/5) PCI SAQ-D questionnaire helpers are included.
